The proof remains intact; the live carrier is an amended repair because Alpha added the required item-specific CRITICAL risk_review to its contract entry.

Reader 4 correctly removed the invalid Tychonoff argument for cylinders with unconstrained noncompact factors and replaced it with compact finite-dimensional bases plus diagonal convergence on active coordinates. Alpha further replaced the false first-n-coordinate normalization with nested finite supports exhausting the active coordinates, synchronized the manifest and contract, and completed the item-specific CRITICAL risk review.

Reader 15 correctly joined the two-source-line layer formula into one display line, preserving the definition while fixing the production renderer. The current definition carrier exactly retains that post-reader repair.

Reader 15 correctly separated the capped terminal cutoff from the preterminal floor estimate. Alpha retained that correction, supplied the refuter's missing proof that each later rounded cutoff strictly increases, updated the contract strategy, and completed the required CRITICAL risk review.

Reader 15 correctly restored the missing inline-math delimiters in Facts F2, F3, and F5. Alpha retained that rendering repair, amended Fact F3 and step 1.2 to relabel the unordered small-block partition decreasingly with all structural invariances stated, and completed the required CRITICAL risk review.

Confirmed: the old step 3.1 chose each next coordinate from a set depending on the already selected prefix, while def-countable-choice covers only a family fixed in advance. The current statement and proof explicitly assume and invoke dependent choice, and every affected countable-product contract and downstream theorem has been synchronized.

Confirmed: the former title asserted a premeasure although the item proves only well-definedness and finite additivity. The current title and conclusion say finitely additive cylinder law, and the irrelevant premeasure dependency has been removed from the item and manifest.

Confirmed as a short proof omission: monotonicity and minimality of q do not imply strict growth below t. Current step 2.1 shows that m_(r-1)+1 is at most both t and ell^(r/2), hence is admissible and forces m_r>=m_(r-1)+1.

Confirmed as a short proof omission: one-directional vertexwise purity does not itself make the pair uniform. Current step 1.1 applies the same structural condition in the reverse direction and uses nonemptiness to rule out two vertices having opposite relations.

Confirmed as a short proof omission: the cited small-block lemma does not order its output. Current step 1.2 explicitly relabels the finite partition by nonincreasing size and records preservation of the partition, bounds, purity, pattern isomorphism, and cross-block structural condition.

Alpha's current-file review found that equality of inverse-image cylinders does not imply equality of finite lifted bases when the full product is empty. The statement now assumes a nonempty product, and step 1.1 fixes x* in the product to complete any finite-coordinate witness; both extension consumers supply that hypothesis through their stated choice principles.

Alpha's HIGH-risk review found two hidden choice uses in countable-union closure: selecting one countable support per event and proving their union countable. The current title, statement, Fact F2, proof, manifest, contract, remarks, and counterexample now state the required countable-choice or stronger AC scope.

Alpha's CRITICAL-risk reread found that repeating a decreasing sequence cannot make its nth cylinder depend on only the first n active coordinates when a cylinder may introduce several coordinates. Current steps 1.1--2.1 instead use nested finite supports H_n containing each original support and the first n active coordinates; they exhaust the active set and make the successive-subsequence limits compatible.
